description: Golden evaluation set for Uber Support AI Agent

fields.actual_agent_reply: What Uber actually replied in the dataset
fields.ground_truth_intent: Correct intent label (from your defined taxonomy)
fields.ground_truth_escalate: bool — should a human agent handle this?
fields.escalation_reason: String reason for escalation (null if auto)
fields.reference_reply: Ideal reply you'd want the agent to send (can match actual_agent_reply)

intent_taxonomy.trip_issue: Wrong route, bad GPS, navigation, driver went wrong way
intent_taxonomy.payment_billing: Overcharge, refund, promo not applied, double charge
intent_taxonomy.safety_incident: Accident, assault, harassment, threatening — ALWAYS ESCALATE
intent_taxonomy.account_access: Login issues, account suspended, password reset
intent_taxonomy.app_technical: App crash, surge pricing bug, booking failure
intent_taxonomy.ride_cancellation: Driver cancelled, can't find driver, excessive surge
intent_taxonomy.lost_item: Left item in car, need to contact driver
intent_taxonomy.wait_time: Driver taking too long, ETA wrong
intent_taxonomy.eats_order: Uber Eats: wrong order, late delivery, missing items
